params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Naafiri''' summons a ''Packmate'' that fights alongside her. She may have up to {{pp|2 to 5 for 4|1;9;12;15|formula=2 at level 1, then +1 at level 9, then +1 every 3 levels until 15}} ''Packmates'' at a time. '''Naafiri''' summons the maximum number of ''Packmates'' when the game starts and upon [[death|respawning]].
params.description2: Hitting {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} with {{tip|abilities}} reduces the {{sti|cooldown}} by 4 seconds. Killing enemies reduces it by 1 second.
params.notes:
* ''Packmates'' do not count as abilities for triggering the cooldown reduction.
* Only the initial hit of ''{{ai|Darkin Daggers|Naafiri}}'' counts for reducing ''We Are More's'' cooldown; the damage over time will not trigger the cooldown reduction.
* Both hits of ''{{ai|Eviscerate|Naafiri}}'' will trigger the cooldown reduction.
params.tips:
* Champions who have repeatable [[unit-targeted]] dashes available in their kit (e.g. {{cai|Bladesurge|Irelia}}, {{cai|Sweeping Blade|Yasuo}}) can utilize ''Packmates'' to effectively reach '''Naafiri'''.
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Naafiri}} periodically summons a ''[[Naafiri#Pets|Packmate]]'' that attacks the target of her attacks and {{tip|abilities}}.
params.blurb2: Hitting {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}} with abilities or killing enemies reduces the {{sti|cooldown}}.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' hurls a dagger in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and inflicts them with a {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds over 5 seconds. The {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} {{tip|execute|executes}} {{tip|minions}} and non-epic {{tip|monsters}} if they would be damaged below {{sti|health|{{as|{{pp|30 to 70 for 11}} health}}}}. ''Darkin Daggers'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds and within 4 seconds at no additional cost.
params.leveling:
{{st|Initial Physical Damage|{{ap|35 to 55}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Bleed Physical Damage per Tick|{{ap|35/10 to 135/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|80/10}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Bleed Physical Damage|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 80% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Total Physical Damage|{{ap|35+35 to 55+135}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20+80}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description2: If the dagger hits a target that is already {{as|bleeding|buzzword3}}, they are instead {{ccs|dealt|physical}} the remaining {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} damage plus {{as|'''additional bonus''' physical damage|physical damage}}, with the '''base bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}} and the ''scaling'' for the '''bonus''' damage increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 250 for 11|0 to 100|formula=2.5% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health, capped at 100% '''missing''' health}}|health}}. If that target is also a {{tip|champion}} or large {{tip|monster}}, '''Naafiri''' {{tip|heal|heals}} herself.
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Darkin Daggers'' calculates its additional damage based on missing health before applying the remaining bleed damage.
* ''Darkin Daggers' '' {{tip|execute}} against minions considers both the damage of the initial hit of the dagger and any bleed tick for putting the target under the threshold.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Naafiri}} hurls a dagger that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit and inflicts a {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} over a short time. ''Darkin Daggers'' can be recast at no additional cost.
params.blurb3: If the target is already {{as|bleeding|buzzword3}}, they are also {{ccs|dealt|physical}} the remaining {{as|bleed|buzzword3}} damage plus {{as|'''additional''' physical damage|physical damage}}. If that target is also a {{tip|champion}}, '''Naafiri''' will {{tip|heal}} herself.

params.icon: Naafiri The Call of the Pack.png
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' goes on the hunt for the next {{tt|5 seconds|Hunt begins from the start of the cast time}}, becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|ghosted}} for the first 1 second and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} all of her active ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' in the first {{fd|0.9}} seconds. Her active ''Packmates'' will {{tip|blink|reappear}} near her after their vanish.
params.description2: After {{fd|1.25}} seconds into the hunt, '''Naafiri''' summons 2 additional ''Packmates'' that last for the remaining duration and can exceed ''{{ais|We Are More|Naafiri}}'' summon cap.
params.description3: While on the hunt, '''Naafiri''' gains {{as|20% AD}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and grants herself and all ''Packmates'' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
params.description4: ''Casting {{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}} extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration by {{fd|1.75}} seconds, up to its original duration.''
params.description5: '''''Naafiri''' can move during The Call of the Pack's cast time.''
params.notes:
* While ''The Call of the Pack'' is active, it increases ''{{ais|We Are More|Naafiri}}'' summon cap to {{pp|4 to 7 for 4|1;9;12;15|formula=4 at level 1, then +1 at level 9, then +1 every 3 levels until 15}}.
* The order of additional ''Packmates'' that despawn is predetermined, most likely their internal spawn IDs. The ability does not consider which ''Packmates'' are the closest or healthiest.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Naafiri}} goes on the hunt for a period, briefly becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|vanish|vanishing}} her ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'', gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and granting herself and her ''Packmates'' {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' move speed}}}}. She will also summon extra ''Packmates'' that last for the hunt's duration.
params.blurb2: ''Casting {{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}} briefly extends The Call of the Pack's hunt duration.''

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} in the target direction and deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description2: ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' {{tip|vanish}} during the dash and {{tip|blink|reappear}} near '''Naafiri''' on her arrival. They are also {{tip|heal|healed}} to full health upon their reappearance.
params.target range: {{dv|{{tt|250 – 450|Minimum and maximum dash distance}}|{{tt|{{ap|450+200}}|Maximum extended dash distance across terrain}}}}
params.notes:
* ''Packmates'' will not be affected by ''Eviscerate'' while under the effect of ''{{ai|Hounds' Pursuit|Naafiri}}''.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Naafiri}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Upon arrival, she explodes in a flurry of blades to deal {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.blurb2: ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' briefly {{tip|vanish}} and {{tip|heal}} to full health.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Naafiri''' and her ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' {{tip|channel}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds to single out the target enemy champion, {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them in the duration. Upon completion of the channel, they {{tip|dash}} to the target; upon arrival '''Naafiri''' deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slows}} the target by 99% for {{fd|0.25}} seconds, whereas each ''Packmate'' deals {{ap|0.1*100}}% of that damage. ''Packmates'' become {{tip|untargetable}} during their channel and dash.
params.leveling:
{{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|125 to 275}} {{as|(+ 100% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Physical Damage per ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|link=*none*|Packmate}}''|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b1}} to {{#var:rp_b3}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
params.description2: If '''Naafiri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 7 seconds of cast, she triggers a pulse that grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|surrounding area|Can see through terrain}} for 1 second and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions within for 4 seconds. She can also recast ''Hounds' Pursuit'' once from triggering this effect within 12 seconds at no cost.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Naafiri''' immediately grants herself a {{tip|shield}} for 3 seconds before mimicking the {{tt|first cast's effects|Excluding the takedown effects, which can trigger only once}}.
params.notes:
* ''Hounds' Pursuit's'' theoretical {{as|'''total''' physical damage}} from ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' '''only''', assuming '''Naafiri''' has the maximum number of them active and ''Hounds' Pursuit'' is always ranked at the earliest {{stil|experience|levels}} permitted (ranks {{ap|1|2|3}} at levels {{ap|6|11|16}}):
** {{sbc|Levels 6–8:}} {{as|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b1}}*2}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*2}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} / ''{{ai|The Call of the Pack|Naafiri|icononly=true}}'' {{as|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b1}}*4}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}.
** {{sbc|Levels 9–10:}} {{as|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b1}}*3}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} / ''{{ai|The Call of the Pack|Naafiri|icononly=true}}'' {{as|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b1}}*5}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}.
** {{sbc|Level 11:}} {{as|{{ap|({{#var:rp_b1}}+({{#var:rp_b3}}-{{#var:rp_b1}})*(1/2))*3}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*3}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} / ''{{ai|The Call of the Pack|Naafiri|icononly=true}}'' {{as|{{ap|({{#var:rp_b1}}+({{#var:rp_b3}}-{{#var:rp_b1}})*(1/2))*5}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}.
** {{sbc|Levels 12–14:}} {{as|{{ap|({{#var:rp_b1}}+({{#var:rp_b3}}-{{#var:rp_b1}})*(1/2))*4}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} / ''{{ai|The Call of the Pack|Naafiri|icononly=true}}'' {{as|{{ap|({{#var:rp_b1}}+({{#var:rp_b3}}-{{#var:rp_b1}})*(1/2))*6}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*6}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}.
** {{sbc|Level 15:}} {{as|{{ap|({{#var:rp_b1}}+({{#var:rp_b3}}-{{#var:rp_b1}})*(1/2))*5}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} / ''{{ai|The Call of the Pack|Naafiri|icononly=true}}'' {{as|{{ap|({{#var:rp_b1}}+({{#var:rp_b3}}-{{#var:rp_b1}})*(1/2))*7}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*7}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}.
** {{sbc|Levels 16–18:}} {{as|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b3}}*5}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}} / ''{{ai|The Call of the Pack|Naafiri|icononly=true}}'' {{as|{{ap|{{#var:rp_b3}}*7}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:rp_ad}}*7}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}.
* '''Naafiri''' marks the enemy champion targeted by ''Hounds' Pursuit'' in order to gain [[assist]] credit on them, lasting for the standard credit timer.
* ''Hound's Pursuit's'' cast and dash do not {{tip|break stealth}}.{{bug|2}}
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block '''Naafiri's''' collision damage but cannot prevent collision damage from ''Packmates''.
* '''Naafiri''' will track the target if they change locations, up to a maximum distance.
** She will dash to the target's previous location if they move too far away during the dash.
* '''Naafiri''' lands ~125 units in front of the target.
* '''Naafiri''' will be ordered to basic attack the target at the end of the dash.
* '''Naafiri''' will windup a basic attack while dashing.{{bug|2}}
* ''Packmates'' hitting the same target as '''Naafiri''' will count as dealing "additional" damage.
* The target is {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} for another {{fd|1.5}} seconds after the channel completes.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Naafiri''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
** If '''Naafiri's''' channel is interrupted, the ''Packmates' '' channels will be canceled as well.
** The channel is cancelled if the target dies or moves too far away, but not if they become {{tip|untargetable}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Naafiri}} and her ''{{ai|We Are More|Naafiri|Packmates}}'' briefly {{tip|channel}} to single out an enemy. They then {{tip|dash}} together toward the target. Upon colliding with the target, '''Naafiri''' deals {{as|physical damage}} to the target and briefly {{tip|slows}} them, whereas ''Packmates'' deal a small portion of that damage. ''Packmates'' are {{tip|untargetable}} during their windup and dash.
params.blurb2: If '''Naafiri''' scores a {{tip|champion}} takedown shortly after, she can recast ''Hounds' Pursuit'' once more within a duration at no cost.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Naafiri''' immediately grants herself a {{tip|shield}}, then performs the first cast's effects again.
